azkar.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

azkar.text: اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك
azkar.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.

azkar.text: باسمك ربي وضعت جنبي وبك أرفعه فإن أمسكت نفسي فارحمها وإن أرسلتها فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين
azkar.transliteration: bismika rabbi wada'tu janbi wa bika arfa'uhu fa in amsakta nafsi farhamha wa in arsaltaha fahfazha bima tahfazu bihi 'ibadaka as-salihin
azkar.translation: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You return it, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
All praise is due to Allah.

azkar.text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
azkar.transliteration: qul huwa allahu ahad, allahu as-samad, lam yalid wa lam yulad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
azkar.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Self-Sufficient. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.

azkar.text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
azkar.transliteration: qul a'udhu bi rabbi al-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq
azkar.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak, from the evil of what He has created.

azkar.text: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
azkar.transliteration: qul a'udhu bi rabbi an-nas, maliki an-nas, ilahi an-nas
azkar.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the King of mankind, the God of mankind.

azkar.text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
azkar.transliteration: allahu la ilaha illa huwa al-hayyu al-qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm
azkar.translation: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him.

azkar.text: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعدما أماتنا وإليه النشور
azkar.transliteration: al-hamdu lillahi alladhi ahyana ba'dama amatana wa ilayhi an-nushur
azkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.

azkar.text: الحمد لله الذي عافاني في جسدي ورد علي روحي
azkar.transliteration: al-hamdu lillahi alladhi 'afani fi jasadi wa radda 'alayya ruhi
azkar.translation: All praise is due to Allah who restored health to my body and returned my soul to me.

azkar.text: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له له الملك وله الحمد
azkar.transliteration: la ilaha illa allahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd
azkar.translation: There is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise.

azkar.text: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ
azkar.transliteration: inna fi khalqi as-samawati wal-ardi wakhtilafi al-layli wan-nahar
azkar.translation: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs.
